sample_unit: rheumatic diseases (ChatGPT-generated texts compared with ACR fact sheets)

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4 patient education text versus ACR fact sheets (FKGL, SMOG, FRE)
links.effect: ChatGPT FKGL 14.3 vs 12.7 (p = 0.007); SMOG p < 0.001; FRE 35.8 vs 43.7 (p < 0.001), indicating greater linguistic complexity.
links.quote: ChatGPT-generated texts had significantly higher FKGL scores (14.3 vs. 12.7; p = 0.007) and SMOG scores (p < 0.001), indicating greater linguistic complexity.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT-generated patient materials relative to appropriate patient level
links.effect: ChatGPT mean FKGL 14.3 (vs 12.7 for ACR); FRE 35.8 vs 43.7, i.e. college-level text with higher complexity.
links.quote: ChatGPT-generated texts had significantly higher FKGL scores (14.3 vs. 12.7; p = 0.007) and SMOG scores (p < 0.001), indicating greater linguistic complexity.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, reliability (DISCERN, EQIP), and similarity of ChatGPT-4 generated patient education texts compared to established ACR fact sheets, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
